name: Hydromol Ointment/Cream
monitoring: Assess skin hydration and tolerability; review for signs of folliculitis if suspected
pregnancy: Considered safe in pregnancy for topical use
sideEffects: Greasy residue, potential for folliculitis with occlusion, fire hazard if fabric with product residue is exposed to ignition
clinicalPearls: Highly occlusive and useful for very dry skin; ointment formulations are more effective but greasier than creams—patient preference affects adherence; warn patients about fire risks
indication: Management of severe dry skin, eczema, ichthyosis and related dermatoses
